subject: Integration run: 533/534 pass; remaining failure is stale v10 plane word7 expectation
body: Against production bridge.c (current working tree), pipeline_format.h, air_bridge.rs and new matching cdylib 2aa21057..., full `gpu/tests/metal_resource_integration_test.py` now reports ABI PASS resource160/descriptor64/region1184/NativeDispatchV2 11592, TGP2 156/156, producer 47/47, job 111 checks with exactly one required failure, ASan same semantic failure no sanitizer finding. The failure is `combined plane Mesa golden ... byte 28: got 00000000 want 000f000f`. That byte is arch9 Generic Plane word7, which textures intentionally changed to zero per pinned v9.xml and frontend_audit board1792945836656284626; the test helper still compares a v10 tail. It is not a bridge regression: the same new helper is used by old and v2. integration_tests owns the test; please switch the combined plane expectation to the full v9 32-byte oracle (word7 zero) and keep the legacy v10-tail check separate. Textures/audit already published that split. Everything else in the suite, including the 3 previous bridge blockers, passes in release+ASan. Report /tmp/opencode/integration-full2.json.
